name: SBOM Generation & Analysis
description: Generation, validation, and analysis of Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs). Covers SPDX and CycloneDX formats, SBOM generation from source and binary analysis, completeness validation, SBOM-driven vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance requirements.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands SBOM purpose, formats, and regulatory context
evidence: Can explain the purpose of SBOMs and their role in supply chain security
Familiar with SPDX and CycloneDX formats
Understands regulatory requirements (EO 14028, EU CRA) related to SBOMs

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Generates SBOMs under supervision using standard tools
evidence: Generated SBOMs using Syft, cdxgen, or similar tools
Validated SBOM format compliance (SPDX, CycloneDX) with schema validators
Compared SBOM contents against actual project dependencies

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently generates, validates, and analyzes SBOMs for engagements
evidence: Independently generated and analyzed SBOMs on 5+ engagements
Assesses SBOM completeness and identifies missing components
Correlates SBOM contents with vulnerability databases for risk assessment
Passed proficiency assessment on SBOM generation and analysis

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex SBOM scenarios; integrates into workflows; assesses quality
evidence: Generates SBOMs for complex multi-language and containerized applications
Integrates SBOM generation into build pipelines
Develops SBOM quality metrics and completeness scoring
Mentors others on SBOM methodology and tooling

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on SBOM methodology; contributes to standards
evidence: Developed the lab's SBOM methodology and governance framework
Contributes to SBOM standard development or community tooling
Advises clients on SBOM compliance requirements and implementation
Trains teams on SBOM generation, analysis, and compliance

assessment_methods.description: Generate SBOMs for a multi-component application, validate completeness, and identify discrepancies
Review of SBOM quality and analysis reports from recent engagements

work_roles: OG-WRL-017 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
